result: At pinned modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, RequestContext<RoleServer> exposes both a public meta: RequestMetaObject field and a public client_capabilities() helper. The helper returns the current request metadata capability value for metadata-required modern sessions. Therefore the smallest handler-side positive assertion can stay inside the existing ContextServer::list_tools scaffold: call context.client_capabilities().is_some_and(|capabilities| capabilities.sampling.is_some()) and record/assert true. A non-default capability can be supplied without depending on struct-field constructors by building ClientCapabilities through serde_json::from_value(serde_json::json!({"sampling": {}})).unwrap(), then passing it to meta.set_client_capabilities(...) before list_tools_request(meta). This directly closes the previously identified source-level API-shape uncertainty without mutating the public repository or executing hosted compute.
